contracts.identity: Sorted IPv4/port endpoints plus protocol; fwd is first observed direction, not key order.
contracts.flow_ids: Positive uint64 IDs, no reuse within a table lifetime; new ID after expiry.
contracts.expiry: Capture watermark never decreases; expire at idle >= timeout before lookup; valid timestamps on malformed frames also advance expiry.
contracts.capacity: Reject new keys only, preserve existing keys; packet remains parsed, output flow_id=untracked and rejection count.
contracts.iat: Microseconds; clamp backward intervals to zero, keep direction timestamp maximum.
contracts.memory: Fixed-size per-flow metadata with no retained packet/payload/string/stream buffer; entry count bounded by configuration.
contracts.tcp: Observed SYN/SYN-ACK/final ACK heuristic plus FIN/RST states; no sequence validation. FIN/RST do not immediately remove a flow.
contracts.exit_codes: 0: EOF, which may include parsing skips or Flow rejections; 1: runtime error; 2: invalid arguments.

acceptance.observed: Three packets retain flow_id=1, directions fwd/bwd/fwd, fwd/bwd packets=2/1, IP bytes=90/45.
Last activity at 2s and same tuple at 122s gives flow_id=2; created=2 active=1 expired=1 rejected=0.
max-flows=1 marks a new UDP tuple untracked, still updates the existing reverse TCP flow; rejected=1, EOF exit=0.

tdd.module_red: Build exit 1 because FlowTable interface did not exist; no runtime unit tests were claimed to run in this first RED.
tdd.cli_red: 8 of 9 new FlowCli tests failed on missing output/settings; invalid-setting regression already passed.
tdd.cli_green: Full suite 101/101 after implementation and 3 real-process checks.
tdd.quality_diagnostic: Initial Release failed on an easily-swapped pair of test-helper arguments; helper changed to TcpMetadata while preserving flag literals and assertions. Production code passed the initial static check.

independent_review.result: Code accepted; final quality/doc checks completed separately by implementer.
independent_review.test_helper_change: Reviewer separately acknowledged typed TcpMetadata helper change without changed assertions or product behavior.

limitations: Expiry scan is O(active flows) per packet; throughput and RSS were not benchmarked.
TCP state is observational; same tuple reused before idle expiry may merge sessions.
Backward capture time uses a watermark approximation, not reconstruction of true event order.
Flow accepts parsed metadata; full header/payload consistency checks remain in parse_packet.
Raw AI state aggregates are stored, but no AI feature vector, inference or IPC is implemented.
No TCP reassembly, rules, live capture, NFQUEUE or real blocking is implemented in A2.
Full tests ran as root; only a demo was checked as a nonprivileged user.
Remote GitHub Actions was not run.
